patterns.name: 引言：改写题目
patterns.frame: The line graph illustrates the changes in [变量] in [地点] between [年] and [年].
patterns.note: 引言只做一件事：改写题目。变量、地点、时间三样齐全，不加原因、不加评价。

variants.zh: 2005 至 2020 年，某国大学生人数的变化。
variants.hint: the number of university students / between ... and ...
variants.en: The line graph illustrates the changes in the number of university students in one country between 2005 and 2020.

variants.zh: 1990 至 2015 年，某市私家车数量的变化。
variants.hint: the number of private cars / one city
variants.en: The line graph illustrates the changes in the number of private cars in one city between 1990 and 2015.

variants.zh: 2000 至 2020 年，某国可再生能源占比的变化。
variants.en: The line graph illustrates the changes in the share of renewable energy in one country between 2000 and 2020.

patterns.name: 概述：两条相反趋势
patterns.frame: Overall, while the figures for A showed an overall downward trend, the data for B experienced a significant surge.
patterns.note: Overview 只写方向与对比，不写数字；while 连接两条相反趋势，一句话收住。

variants.zh: 报纸销量持续下降，网络新闻阅读量大幅上升。
variants.en: Overall, while the figures for newspapers showed an overall downward trend, the data for online news experienced a significant surge.

variants.zh: 市中心自行车出行下降，私家车出行上升。
variants.en: Overall, while the figures for cycling showed an overall downward trend, the data for private cars experienced a significant surge.

variants.zh: 制造业就业下降，服务业就业上升。
variants.en: Overall, while the figures for manufacturing showed an overall downward trend, the data for the service sector experienced a significant surge.

patterns.name: 上升组：起点、过程、终点
patterns.frame: The most striking growth was seen in A. Starting at X in YEAR, it experienced modest growth before surging to Y by YEAR.
patterns.note: 上升组必须给起点、过程、终点；before surging to 把两个阶段压进一句，避免流水账。

variants.zh: 互联网使用率从 2000 年的 20% 缓慢增长，到 2020 年升至 85%。
variants.en: The most striking growth was seen in internet use. Starting at 20% in 2000, it experienced modest growth before surging to 85% by 2020.

variants.zh: 回收率从 2005 年的 10% 稳步上升，到 2020 年达到 45%。
variants.en: The most striking growth was seen in the recycling rate. Starting at 10% in 2005, it experienced modest growth before surging to 45% by 2020.

variants.zh: 线上课程注册人数从 2015 年的 5 万增长到 2020 年的 40 万。
variants.hint: online course enrolments / before surging to 400,000
variants.en: The most striking growth was seen in online course enrolments. Starting at 50,000 in 2015, it experienced modest growth before surging to 400,000 by 2020.

patterns.name: 下降组：波动后下滑
patterns.frame: In stark contrast, the trend for A was more volatile. It started at X, and after a period of fluctuation, it entered a sustained downward trajectory, plummeting to Y by YEAR.
patterns.note: 波动 + 下降要两个动作：先 fluctuate，再 enter a downward trajectory；plummet 收尾。

variants.zh: 制造业就业从 30% 起步，1990 至 2000 年间波动，之后持续下降，到 2020 年跌至 12%。
variants.en: In stark contrast, the trend for manufacturing employment was more volatile. It started at 30%, and after a period of fluctuation between 1990 and 2000, it entered a sustained downward trajectory, plummeting to 12% by 2020.

variants.zh: 纸质书销量从 2005 年的高位波动，随后持续下滑，2019 年跌到原来的一半。
variants.hint: paper book sales / plummeting to half its 2005 level
variants.en: In stark contrast, the trend for paper book sales was more volatile. It started at a peak in 2005, and after a period of fluctuation, it entered a sustained downward trajectory, plummeting to half its 2005 level by 2019.

variants.zh: 固定电话拥有率从 60% 起步，先小幅波动，之后一路下滑到 25%。
variants.en: In stark contrast, the trend for fixed-line ownership was more volatile. It started at 60%, and after a period of fluctuation, it entered a sustained downward trajectory, plummeting to 25%.

patterns.name: 平稳组：一句话带过
patterns.frame: Meanwhile, A showed relative stability, standing at around X% throughout the period.
patterns.note: 平稳组不展开；showed relative stability / standing at 是固定搭配。

variants.zh: 家庭用水在整个时期稳定在 20% 左右。
variants.en: Meanwhile, household water use showed relative stability, standing at around 20% throughout the period.

variants.zh: 铁路客运占比在 1990 至 2010 年间稳定在 8% 左右。
variants.en: Meanwhile, the rail passenger share showed relative stability, standing at around 8% between 1990 and 2010.

variants.zh: 农业就业比例在整个时期保持在 5% 左右。
variants.en: Meanwhile, agricultural employment showed relative stability, standing at around 5% throughout the period.

patterns.name: 引言：没有时间变化
patterns.frame: The bar chart illustrates the proportions of [变量] in [地点] in [年].
patterns.note: 静态图没有时间变化，用 proportions of，不要写 changes。

variants.zh: 2019 年某国家庭开支的构成比例。
variants.en: The bar chart illustrates the proportions of household spending in one country in 2019.

variants.zh: 2020 年某国能源来源的构成比例。
variants.en: The bar chart illustrates the proportions of energy sources in one country in 2020.

variants.zh: 2018 年大学生时间分配的构成比例。
variants.en: The bar chart illustrates the proportions of time allocated to different activities by university students in 2018.

patterns.name: 概述：最大与最小
patterns.frame: Overall, A accounted for the largest share of X, while B constituted the smallest proportion.
patterns.note: 静态图 Overview 抓最大最小；account for / constitute 换着用，避免重复。

variants.zh: 住房占比最大，其他支出占比最小。
variants.en: Overall, housing accounted for the largest share of spending, while other items constituted the smallest proportion.

variants.zh: 煤炭占比最大，可再生能源占比最小。
variants.en: Overall, coal accounted for the largest share of energy, while renewables constituted the smallest proportion.

variants.zh: 学习占时间最多，锻炼占时间最少。
variants.en: Overall, study accounted for the largest share of students' time, while exercise constituted the smallest proportion.

patterns.name: 主导组：前两名合并
patterns.frame: Regarding the two dominant sectors, they share a similar pattern. A ranked as the primary source, accounting for X%, closely followed by B at Y%.
patterns.note: 前两名合并成一句：ranked as / closely followed by，避免两句流水账。

variants.zh: 煤炭 40% 与石油 35% 是最主要的两个能源来源。
variants.en: Regarding the two dominant sectors, they share a similar pattern. Coal ranked as the primary source, accounting for 40%, closely followed by oil at 35%.

variants.zh: 住房 35% 与食品 25% 是最大的两项开支。
variants.en: Regarding the two dominant sectors, they share a similar pattern. Housing ranked as the primary source, accounting for 35%, closely followed by food at 25%.

variants.zh: 私家车 45% 与公交 30% 是主要出行方式。
variants.en: Regarding the two dominant sectors, they share a similar pattern. Private cars ranked as the primary source, accounting for 45%, closely followed by public transport at 30%.

patterns.name: 少数组：用倍数挂靠
patterns.frame: A played a far smaller role, at only X%, which was about half of the figure for B.
patterns.note: 少数组不要单独报数，用倍数挂到主体上：about half of / a quarter of / a tenth of。

variants.zh: 可再生能源仅占 10%，约为煤炭的四分之一。
variants.en: Renewables played a far smaller role, at only 10%, which was about a quarter of the figure for coal.

variants.zh: 骑行仅占 5%，约为开车的十分之一。
variants.en: Cycling played a far smaller role, at only 5%, which was about a tenth of the figure for driving.

variants.zh: 娱乐支出仅占 8%，约为住房的四分之一。
variants.en: Leisure played a far smaller role, at only 8%, which was about a quarter of the figure for housing.

patterns.name: 引言：先定主语
patterns.frame: The table provides a breakdown of the percentages of [人群] giving an 'excellent' rating across [方面] in [对象].
patterns.note: 表格题先定主语：是「人的比例」，不是设施本身。

variants.zh: 2019 年学生对三门课程各方面给出「优秀」评价的比例。
variants.en: The table provides a breakdown of the percentages of students giving an 'excellent' rating across three courses in 2019.

variants.zh: 2020 年顾客对三家酒店各方面给出「优秀」评价的比例。
variants.en: The table provides a breakdown of the percentages of guests giving an 'excellent' rating across three hotels in 2020.

variants.zh: 2021 年员工对培训项目各方面给出「优秀」评价的比例。
variants.en: The table provides a breakdown of the percentages of employees giving an 'excellent' rating across training programmes in 2021.

patterns.name: 概述：谁最捧场
patterns.frame: Overall, [群体] recorded the highest proportions across most aspects.
patterns.note: Overview 找「谁最捧场」，一句收住；across most aspects 比 in all 稳。

variants.zh: 商科学生在多数方面评价最高。
variants.en: Overall, commerce students recorded the highest proportions across most aspects.

variants.zh: 五星酒店在多数方面评价最高。
variants.en: Overall, the five-star hotel recorded the highest proportions across most aspects.

variants.zh: 年轻员工在多数方面评价最高。
variants.en: Overall, younger employees recorded the highest proportions across most aspects.

patterns.name: 反差组：先总后分
patterns.frame: In stark contrast, the figures for [群体] were generally lower. In particular, [项目] was the weakest-rated aspect at merely X%.
patterns.note: 反差组先总后分：In stark contrast 起句，In particular 落到最低项。

variants.zh: 公众的评价普遍较低，尤其「信息」一项仅为 20%。
variants.en: In stark contrast, the figures for the general public were generally lower. In particular, information was the weakest-rated aspect at merely 20%.

variants.zh: 经济型酒店评价普遍较低，尤其「服务」一项仅为 35%。
variants.en: In stark contrast, the figures for the budget hotel were generally lower. In particular, service was the weakest-rated aspect at merely 35%.

variants.zh: 新员工评价普遍较低，尤其「反馈」一项仅为 18%。
variants.en: In stark contrast, the figures for new employees were generally lower. In particular, feedback was the weakest-rated aspect at merely 18%.

patterns.name: 分类与包含：comprising
patterns.frame: The table gives a breakdown of [类别] who were [状态]. On average, X% of all [单位], comprising [数量], were in this position.
patterns.note: 两个考点：breakdown of 后面接复数类别；comprising 是分词插入语，前后加逗号，用来补人数。

variants.zh: 这张表格细分了生活在贫困中的不同类型家庭。平均而言，11% 的家庭（包含近两百万人）处于这种状况。
variants.hint: gives a breakdown of / comprising / in this position
variants.en: The table gives a breakdown of the different types of family who were living in poverty. On average, 11% of all households, comprising almost two million people, were in this position.

variants.zh: 这张表格细分了做兼职的不同类型学生。平均而言，40% 的本科生（包含近三万人）处于这种状况。
variants.en: The table gives a breakdown of the different types of student who were working part-time. On average, 40% of all undergraduates, comprising nearly 30,000 people, were in this position.

variants.zh: 这张表格细分了远程办公的不同类型员工。平均而言，25% 的员工（包含近五百人）处于这种状况。
variants.en: The table gives a breakdown of the different types of employee who were working remotely. On average, 25% of all staff, comprising almost 500 people, were in this position.

patterns.name: 倍数与独立结构：consisting of
patterns.frame: However, those consisting of [构成] had almost double this proportion of [人群], with X% and Y% respectively.
patterns.note: those + 分词 是独立结构，不要再加 who；倍数用 almost double this proportion；两个数字用 with ... respectively 收尾。

variants.zh: 然而，仅由单亲或单身成年人组成的家庭，其贫困人口比例几乎是这个数字的两倍，分别为 21% 和 19%。
variants.hint: consisting of / almost double / with ... respectively
variants.en: However, those consisting of only one parent or a single adult had almost double this proportion of poor people, with 21% and 19% respectively.

variants.zh: 然而，仅由十人以下小公司或个体经营者构成的雇主，其兼职员工比例几乎是这个数字的两倍，分别为 32% 和 28%。
variants.hint: fewer than ten employees / sole traders
variants.en: However, those consisting of fewer than ten employees or sole traders had almost double this proportion of part-time workers, with 32% and 28% respectively.

variants.zh: 然而，仅由研究生或夜校学员组成的学习者，其线上学习比例几乎是这个数字的两倍，分别为 45% 和 38%。
variants.en: However, those consisting of postgraduate students or evening-course learners had almost double this proportion of online learners, with 45% and 38% respectively.

patterns.name: 比较级与形式主语：It is noticeable that
patterns.frame: It is noticeable that for both types of [群体], a higher than average proportion were [状态] at this time. [群体] generally tended to be better off.
patterns.note: It is noticeable that 引出反差；higher than average 放名词前；tended to be better off 是固定搭配。

variants.zh: 值得注意的是，对于有孩子的这两类家庭，此时生活在贫困中的比例高于平均水平。情侣通常更宽裕。
variants.hint: household with children / higher than average / better off
variants.en: It is noticeable that for both types of household with children, a higher than average proportion were living in poverty at this time. Couples generally tended to be better off.

variants.zh: 值得注意的是，对于有孩子的这两类员工，此时做兼职的比例高于平均水平。资深员工通常更宽裕。
variants.en: It is noticeable that for both types of employee with children, a higher than average proportion were working part-time at this time. Senior staff generally tended to be better off.

variants.zh: 值得注意的是，对于有孩子的这两类学生，此时非全日制学习的比例高于平均水平。成年学生通常更宽裕。
variants.en: It is noticeable that for both types of student with children, a higher than average proportion were studying part-time at this time. Mature students generally tended to be better off.

upgrades.zh: 2020 年电动车销量大幅上升。
upgrades.en: Electric vehicle sales surged in 2020.
upgrades.why: surge 是不及物动词，直接跟 in + 时间；不要说 were surged。

upgrades.en: Paper book sales plummeted after 2008.
upgrades.why: plummet 比 fall 重，适合暴跌；常接 to + 终点。

upgrades.en: Rural incomes climbed gradually.
upgrades.why: gradually 放动词后；climb 已含上升，不再加 up。

upgrades.zh: 油价在 60 到 90 美元之间波动。
upgrades.en: Oil prices fluctuated between $60 and $90.
upgrades.why: fluctuate between A and B 是固定结构。

upgrades.zh: 游客数量在八月达到峰值。
upgrades.en: Visitor numbers peaked in August.
upgrades.why: peak 作动词：peak at + 数值 / in + 月份。

upgrades.en: Unemployment bottomed out in 2010.
upgrades.why: bottom out 是「触底」，之后常回升。

upgrades.en: The market share remained stable at around 20%.
upgrades.why: remain stable at + 数值；stable 是形容词。

upgrades.en: Online sales overtook in-store sales in 2020.
upgrades.why: overtake 直接带宾语，不加 the place of。

upgrades.zh: 城市住房成本远高于农村。
upgrades.en: Housing costs are considerably higher in cities than in rural areas.
upgrades.why: 修饰比较级用 considerably / significantly，不用 very。

upgrades.en: The unemployment rate declined marginally.
upgrades.why: marginally = 略微，常与 decline / rise 搭配。

upgrades.en: Technology is changing rapidly.
upgrades.why: rapidly 修饰变化速度；quickly 偏口语。

upgrades.en: Unemployment rose sharply in 2020.
upgrades.why: sharply 表幅度陡，suddenly 表时间突然。

upgrades.zh: 我认为塑料袋应该被禁用。
upgrades.en: In my view, plastic bags should be banned.
upgrades.why: In my view 后接逗号，比 I think 更书面。

upgrades.zh: 很多人认为大学只应教职业技能。
upgrades.en: It is widely believed that universities should teach only job skills.
upgrades.why: 形式主语 it，避免 many people 开头。

upgrades.zh: 有人主张取消家庭作业。
upgrades.en: Some argue that homework should be abolished.
upgrades.why: argue that 比 say 更适合学术论证。

upgrades.en: Early education is crucial.
upgrades.why: crucial 后常接 to / for + 名词。

upgrades.en: Exercise is beneficial to mental health.
upgrades.why: beneficial to 是固定搭配。

upgrades.en: Prolonged stress is detrimental to health.
upgrades.why: detrimental to 比 harmful 更学术。

upgrades.zh: 由于成本上升，公司裁减了岗位。
upgrades.en: Companies cut jobs due to rising costs.
upgrades.why: due to + 名词；because + 从句。

upgrades.en: Therefore, the government should increase investment.
upgrades.why: Therefore 放句首加逗号；句中对应用 thus。

upgrades.zh: 然而，这项政策也有缺点。
upgrades.en: However, this policy also has drawbacks.
upgrades.why: However 后加逗号；学术写作少用 But 起句。

upgrades.zh: 芬兰的教育体系就是一个例子。
upgrades.en: A case in point is the Finnish education system.
upgrades.why: a case in point is + 名词，比 for example 更紧凑。

upgrades.en: On balance, the benefits outweigh the drawbacks.
upgrades.why: on balance = 权衡之后；结尾避免 in conclusion 套话。

upgrades.zh: 此外，远程办公节省通勤时间。
upgrades.en: Moreover, remote work saves commuting time.
upgrades.why: Moreover 后加逗号，用于递进。

upgrades.zh: 尽管经济增长，贫困依然存在。
upgrades.en: Despite economic growth, poverty persists.
upgrades.why: despite + 名词；although + 从句。

upgrades.zh: 空气污染导致呼吸系统疾病。
upgrades.en: Air pollution leads to respiratory diseases.
upgrades.why: lead to + 名词，比 cause 更中性。

upgrades.zh: 政府必须解决住房危机。
upgrades.en: Governments must tackle the housing crisis.
upgrades.why: tackle 强调着手处理，solve 强调已解决。

upgrades.en: Internships enhance employability.
upgrades.why: enhance + 抽象名词（能力、效率、体验）。

upgrades.en: Plastic use must be curbed.
upgrades.why: curb 常与 use / emissions / spending 搭配。

upgrades.en: Technology facilitates communication.
upgrades.why: facilitate 后接过程或交流，不接人。

upgrades.en: Farmers utilise water-saving technology.
upgrades.why: utilise 更正式，强调有效利用。

upgrades.en: Students can obtain scholarships.
upgrades.why: obtain 用于正式获得（学位、许可、资金）。

upgrades.zh: 数据表明了一个明显的趋势。
upgrades.en: The data demonstrate a clear trend.
upgrades.why: data 作复数，谓语用 demonstrate。

upgrades.en: Individuals should reduce waste.
upgrades.why: individuals 强调个体责任，比 people 精确。

upgrades.zh: 老年人需要更好的护理。
upgrades.en: The elderly need better care.
upgrades.why: the + 形容词表群体，谓语用复数。

upgrades.zh: 年轻人花太多时间在屏幕上。
upgrades.en: Youngsters spend too much time on screens.
upgrades.why: youngsters 偏青少年，children 指更小的孩子。

upgrades.en: The authorities should tighten regulation.
upgrades.why: the authorities 指政府部门，谓语用复数。

upgrades.zh: 该方案的主要优点在于成本低。
upgrades.en: The main merit of this scheme is its low cost.
upgrades.why: merit 可数，常与 main / considerable 搭配。

upgrades.en: The main drawback is the high cost.
upgrades.why: drawback 可数；downside 偏口语。

upgrades.en: The housing issue is becoming more serious.
upgrades.why: issue 更中性，problem 更强调困难。
